test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**gains.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Refer to the following lines from the passage:
 
 
• ** On one hand, access to information and knowledge at the click of a button is a veritable boon to everyon**e (especially students) and this has made our lives much simpler.
 
• On the other hand,** it has severely limited actual contact with teachers, friends and elders. **
 
 
 
• **​**The blank 3 mentions how what the children learn nowadays is incomplete.
 
 
• Thus, the correct word to use in this context would be "gains."
 
• "Gain" means to gradually get more of something.
 
• Example: The train was gaining speed.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3.**
